title: gentianella peruviana var. boliviana
intro: Gentianella peruviana var. boliviana, commonly known as Bolivian gentian, is a species of flowering plant in the gentian family, Gentianaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in the treatment of various conditions, including infections and fever. The therapeutic actions of Bolivian gentian include stimulating digestion, improving appetite, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include xanthones, flavonoids, and iridoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its therapeutic actions.
